items.title: Grafana Applies SLOs and Error Budgets to AI Agent Behaviour
items.blurb: Grafana Labs is proposing a familiar reliability engineering approach for one of the less familiar problems in modern software: how to measure whether an AI agent is actually behaving well. By Craig Risi

items.title: Why Is My Kubernetes Job Still Pending? Tracing Kueue Admission with Headlamp
items.blurb: You submit a Kubernetes Job and wait for its Pods to appear. A minute passes. Then another. The Job is still suspended, there are no application logs, and there may not even be a Pod to inspect.

items.title: Go Was Burning 60% CPU Just Running GC. The Fix Was a Memory Limit.
items.blurb: A Go service can burn CPU collecting garbage without having a memory leak. That is the counterintuitive part of Zomato's Go garbage collection story.
